properties.project_name: UCSF Mission Bay Housing North Building
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: 'student/faculty' housing (here and in earlier notes) is not confirmed by readable sources, which say students, postdoctoral scholars and their families (Langan; Regents 2002); the housing-office page cited for that and for 'opened together around 2005' could not be read in the audit, and the Regents item only anticipated full occupancy by October 2005. Notes rewritten to say so; the Hearst-specific unit count and street address were removed. The arcCA Digest page and the Regents item were added to source_doc_urls.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in the repo's DataSF parcels copy) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: Part of a single UCSF Mission Bay student housing complex (Hearst Tower plus North, West and South/Student Housing buildings; the building names come from UCSF's housing-office page, which could not be read in the 2026-09 audit) -- UC's Block 20 Housing and Retail Project: four buildings totaling 298,800 sq ft housing more than 750 UCSF students, postdoctoral scholars and their families around a shared courtyard (Langan). The November 2002 UC Regents item anticipated full occupancy by October 2005; no source read states the actual opening. Architect Skidmore, Owings & Merrill (SOM) with Fisher Friedman Associates (arcCA Digest: 'student apartment complex by SOM with Fisher-Friedman'). This building: the North Building, 525 Nelson Rising Lane (OpenStreetMap), a 7-10 story mid-rise.
